stem: How did the First Amendment protection of religious freedom affect U.S. society in the early history of the country?

options.label: A
options.text: It prevented conflict between individuals who were members of different religions.

options.label: B
options.text: It prevented the government from making laws prohibiting the practice of certain religious beliefs.

options.label: C
options.text: It allowed for state governments to unify their citizens under one common religion.

options.label: D
options.text: It allowed for the preservation of many religious places through government support.

visual_elements: 4 multiple choice answer boxes labeled A to D
